name: Georgia Goodsell
story: A Women in Spatial + Survey committee biography describes Georgia Goodsell’s geography background and her work as a Spatial Intelligence Technician at the Ministry for Primary Industries. It also records her interest in encouraging women entering spatial work and supporting people new to GIS.

The network’s committee biographies represent different career stages, from Amy Tay’s transport and infrastructure consulting to Georgia Goodsell’s spatial-intelligence work, Devon Allen’s surveying experience and Malindi Reihana-Ruka’s interests as a student representative. A 2024 event recap also describes talks on tactile mapping, surveying, GIS in schools and field data collection.
